questions.title: Which NBA team will LeBron James choose for the 2026–27 season?
questions.background: This question concerns James's publicly announced team choice for the upcoming NBA season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : James's public announcement of his team choice for the 2026–27 season during the 2026 offseason, corroborated by reputable news or sports reporting. Resolution Date : Resolve when James publicly announces that choice. A completed contract signing or appearance in a game is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the NBA team he chooses.
questions.current_reasoning: July 6 Kalshi pricing (SI.com: Cavs 57%, Warriors 18%, Heat 10%; AL.com: Cavs 55%, Warriors 18%, Heat 14%, 76ers 6%, Timberwolves 5%, Knicks 3%, Nuggets 2%, Spurs 2%) shows a decisive move toward Cleveland and a sharp collapse in Philadelphia's odds since July 4. Marc Stein reported rival teams increasingly view Cleveland as 'the scenario to beat' with whispers the Cavaliers are keeping an open roster spot to trade for Bronny James (pushing Bronny-to-Cleveland Kalshi odds to 53%), while Golden State's Anthony Davis pursuit faltered, Miami boosted its pitch by acquiring Giannis Antetokounmpo, and ESPN's Bobby Marks noted Philadelphia ($205.8M payroll) can only offer a minimum deal despite strong Klutch/Tyrese Maxey/Jaylen Brown/Mike Gansey connections (CBS News July 6). Blending vig-adjusted Kalshi prices with slight dampening for unconfirmed free-agency volatility: Cleveland rises 0.45 -> 0.53, Golden State trims 0.19 -> 0.18, Miami edges up 0.11 -> 0.12 (passing Philly), Philadelphia drops sharply 0.16 -> 0.07, and Minnesota Timberwolves enter at #5 (0.04), replacing Denver Nuggets (now ~0.02 in the 6% residual alongside Knicks/Spurs).

local_articles.title: Stephen Curry has a simple pitch to entice LeBron James to join Golden State Warriors
local_articles.snippet: LOS ANGELES – Golden State Warriors star Stephen Curry would love to play with LeBron James, but he knows he’s not the only one who feels the same as the NBA’s all-time leading scorer ponders where he’ll play next. James, 41, told the Los Angeles Lakers last week that he was departing after eight seasons and a title in Southern California. “I feel like any place he calls and says ‘I want to play there,’ you move mountains to make it happen,” Curry said on July 9 at a press conference before the American Century Championship celebrity golf tournament in Nevada. Curry said his pitch to James – his teammate on the United States’ gold medal-winning team at the Paris Olympics – was simple. “The pitch is: Do you want to play good basketball and be around people that know how to play the game,” said the 38-year-old, who even added golf for good measure. “Raise our floor, competitiveness. questions.title: If Morgan Rogers leaves Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will he join?
questions.background: Morgan Rogers is an England international and an attacking player for Aston Villa.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement from either club confirming a completed permanent transfer, corroborated by reputable sports reporting. Resolution Conditions : Conditional on Rogers completing a permanent transfer away from Aston Villa during the 2026 summer transfer window, resolve to the acquiring club. If he completes multiple transfers during the window, use his first permanent transfer from Aston Villa. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the acquiring football club.
questions.current_reasoning: No competing club bid has emerged for Morgan Rogers through June 30, while two major rival hijack threats weakened sharply over June 26-29: Manchester City committed £116m to Nottingham Forest for Elliot Anderson plus £17m compensation to Chelsea for new manager Enzo Maresca (confirmed June 29, with AFP citing Bournemouth's Eli Junior Kroupi as City's next attacking target), and June 29 BBC Sport reports PSG are prioritizing a massive move for RB Leipzig's Yan Diomande (~£129m valuation) as one of their one or two marquee summer additions. Conditional on Rogers leaving Aston Villa, trimming Manchester City (0.09 -> 0.05) and PSG (0.05 -> 0.03) consolidates frontrunner Arsenal (0.64 -> 0.67) and Chelsea (0.13 -> 0.14), while widening the residual tail from 5% to 7% to account for a possible Liverpool pivot if they lose Diomande to PSG.

local_articles.title: Morgan Rogers backs Harry Kane to outshine Erling Haaland in World Cup showdown
local_articles.snippet: – England’s Morgan Rogers backed Harry Kane to come out on top when he faces Norway’s Erling Haaland in an enticing battle between the World Cup sharpshooters on July 11. The forwards, who will meet in the quarter-finals in Miami, are among the frontrunners in a thrilling race for the tournament’s Golden Boot award, along with Lionel Messi and France’s Kylian Mbappe. Aston Villa forward Rogers admitted Manchester City’s Haaland, who has scored seven goals so far, was almost impossible to stop. “Has anyone ever stopped Erling Haaland? I’m not sure they have, but we’re going to try,” the 23-year-old said at England’s Kansas City base camp on July 8. “He’s such an unbelievable player. questions.title: Who will win the middleweight main event at UFC Fight Night in Oklahoma City on July 18, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official UFC results or contemporaneous reporting from reputable news organizations. Resolution : Resolve to the fighter officially declared the winner of the event’s middleweight main event on fight night, excluding any subsequent changes to the result. Accepted Answer Format : The winning fighter’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Officially announced June 20-21, the UFC Fight Night Oklahoma City main event on July 18 pits former middleweight champion Dricus du Plessis (23-3, age 32, No. 2 MW) against former welterweight champion Kamaru Usman (21-4, age 39) over five rounds at 185 lbs. Du Plessis holds major advantages in youth, natural middleweight size, durability, and striking volume, while Usman's elite wrestling poses a live stylistic threat after Chimaev out-wrestled Du Plessis at UFC 319 and Usman beat Joaquin Buckley in June 2025. Leaving 3% for draw/no-contest or late injury replacement, Du Plessis is a clear ~67% favorite to Usman's 30%.

questions.title: Who will hold the men's outdoor mile world record immediately after the 2026 London Diamond League meeting?
questions.background: The London meeting is part of the annual Diamond League track-and-field series.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : World Athletics reports or reputable contemporaneous news coverage of the London Diamond League meeting on July 18, 2026. Resolution : Resolve to the athlete credited as the men's outdoor mile world-record holder at the conclusion of the meeting. If no new world record is set, resolve to the existing record holder. Later administrative ratification is not required if the performance is reported as a world record. Accepted Answer Format : The athlete's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Hicham El Guerrouj's 3:43.13 outdoor mile world record has stood since July 1999, and no runner has broken 3:43.73 even in the super-shoe era. Great Britain's Josh Kerr announced 'Project 222' to attack the record in the Emsley Carr Mile at the London Diamond League on July 18 with custom Brooks spikes, but his PB (3:45.34) is 2.21 seconds slower than the mark. Jakob Ingebrigtsen (3:43.73 PB, returning from fall 2025 Achilles surgery) and Yared Nuguse (3:43.97) have come closest and could target records in a non-championship summer, yet base rates strongly favor El Guerrouj's record surviving through July 18 (~76%).

questions.title: Which Gaza locality will be the site of the deadliest Israeli strike reported on July 17, 2026?
questions.background: A ceasefire between Israel and Hamas took effect in October 2025, but Israeli attacks in Gaza have continued.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Al Jazeera's July 17, 2026 reporting on that day's attacks across Gaza. Compare individual strikes rather than cumulative deaths across separate attacks. Resolution Date : 2026-07-17 Accepted Answer Format : Resolve to the city, town, or refugee camp where the individual Israeli strike with the highest reported death toll occurred. Answer with the locality's name.
questions.current_reasoning: Despite the October 2025 Gaza ceasefire, Al Jazeera reporting in May-June 2026 shows near-daily Israeli strikes killing over 1,027 Palestinians since October, concentrated heavily in Gaza's main populated hubs outside Israel's eastern 'Yellow Line' buffer zones. Recent Al Jazeera casualty reports repeatedly center on Gaza City (which aggregates strikes across major neighborhoods like Zeitoun and Rimal), Khan Younis, central Gaza's Deir el-Balah and Nuseirat refugee camp (site of the May 24 strike killing a family of three), and the crowded tent encampments of al-Mawasi (struck on June 7 and June 24). Because single-day strike locations are inherently noisy, 20% probability mass is left for other localities such as Jabalia, Rafah, Bureij, Maghazi, and Beit Lahiya.

local_articles.title: The search for Gaza’s missing brings heartbreak and closure for loved ones
local_articles.snippet: On November 16, 2023, the Haji family home in the al-Zaitoun neighbourhood of Gaza City lived happily under one roof, none expecting it to be their last day together. The three-storey building was filled with the lives of more than 30 extended family members, ranging from four-years-old to 40, until an Israeli air raid reduced their home to rubble. questions.title: Who will be appointed head of Syria’s National Security Bureau in July 2026?
questions.background: The National Security Bureau oversees Syria’s security agencies.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Syrian government announcement or reporting by the Syrian state news agency SANA identifying the person appointed head of the National Security Bureau during July 2026. Resolution Date : The date the appointment is publicly announced. Accepted Answer Format : The appointee’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Syria's Ba'athist National Security Bureau was dissolved after Bashar al-Assad's fall, and President Ahmed al-Sharaa established a National Security Council in March 2025 alongside a restructured General Intelligence Service (initially led by Anas Khattab, who became Interior Minister in spring 2025, and since May 2025 by Hussein al-Salama). If Damascus establishes or revives a National Security Bureau in July 2026 to coordinate security agencies, sitting General Intelligence chief Hussein al-Salama and Interior Minister/former spy chief Anas Khattab (al-Sharaa's top security architect) are the leading internal candidates, followed by Defense Minister Murhaf Abu Qasra, Chief of General Staff Ali Noureddine al-Naasan, and senior presidential/interior insider Ali Keda. Given Damascus's history of elevating lesser-known former HTS security commanders whose full names emerge only upon SANA announcement, a full 50% tail mass is left outside these five figures.

local_articles.title: Bomb attacks rattle Damascus but for most Syrians, life goes on
local_articles.snippet: Damascus, Syria – At a cafe in central Damascus, lines of chairs sat dormant outside an empty cafe. Mohammad al-Dahabi, the cafe’s owner, pulled away one chair, revealing a small crater on the floor. “This is where the explosion happened,” al-Dahabi said about the July 2 bomb blast that took place at the cafe close to Damascus’s Justice Palace and killed at least 10 people. “If it had gone off a half hour later, everyone would have [already] left for the day.” Damascus was hit by three explosions over the past week, with one on July 2 followed by two more blasts on July 7 near the Four Seasons Hotel, where French President Emmanuel Macron was staying during a visit to the Syrian capital. That attack killed one person and wounded 36.
